messages.subject: MDIFF with GPCM or PCM?
parts:
Dear Phill and community,

I have a question regarding the MDIFF function. It was documented that the calculation of multidimensional item difficulty is only possible, if dichotomous or graded model was estimated. I wanted to ask why and if it would be wrong to preform the same calculations on PCM/GPCM models?

Thank you very much in advance for any help!
Milica

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: MDIFF with GPCM or PCM?
parts:
It may be possible to locate a suitable multidimensional difficulty index for these and other item types, however the current linear algebra expression in the function may not be the way to go (hence why it is not implicitly supported). Are you aware of any derivations for these item types that propose such a statistic --- and if so, could you bring them to my attention?

Phil
